module.purpose: Provides a small geometry utility for extracting text-label geometries from individual shapes or grouped geometry.
module.summary: This module exposes a pure helper that inspects a geometry object, returns it when it is itself label-bearing, otherwise filters direct children when the object is a group, and yields an empty collection for all other geometry forms. It supports text-label discovery without mutating geometry or crossing external boundaries.
module.businessContext: Supports diagram and canvas rendering workflows that need to identify text labels associated with shapes. Failure would omit labels from downstream layout, rendering, or interaction behavior.
functions: getTextLabels (~L10-20): Extracts label geometries from individual or grouped geometry
systemCapabilities: Provide empty results for unlabeled geometry

sectionMap.name: label-self check
sectionMap.intent: Returns the input geometry when it directly represents a label.

sectionMap.name: group-child filtering
sectionMap.intent: Filters direct children for label-bearing geometries when input is a group.

sectionMap.name: empty fallback
sectionMap.intent: Returns no labels for unsupported non-group geometry.

edgeCases.behavior: Returns a single-element array containing the geometry.

edgeCases.inputShape: A Group2d with no label children
edgeCases.behavior: Returns an empty array after filtering direct children.

edgeCases.inputShape: A Group2d with mixed label and non-label children

invariants.description: The result contains only the input geometry or direct children whose label flag is true.
The input geometry and its children are inspected without mutation.

assumptions.description: Callers provide a valid Geometry2d instance compatible with the imported geometry model.
Group2d exposes a children collection whose elements provide an isLabel property.

concurrencyModel.notes: The helper performs synchronous property inspection and filtering without shared mutable state.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A geometry marked as a label is passed to the function.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Preserves a label geometry as the sole returned text label.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A group geometry contains both label and non-label children.
given: geometry.children contains children where child.isLabel is both true and false
moduleContractTests.then: the result contains only children where child.isLabel is true
moduleContractTests.rationale: Ensures grouped geometries expose only their direct text-label children.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A geometry is neither a label nor a group.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards the default behavior for unsupported geometry types.

units.name: getTextLabels

detail.name: getTextLabels
postconditions: If geometry.isLabel is true, returns an array containing the same geometry object.
If geometry is a Group2d, returns only its direct children whose isLabel property is true.
invariants: The function does not mutate the supplied geometry or its children.
Returned group children preserve their original order.
No descendants beyond direct Group2d children are searched.
edgeCases: A geometry with isLabel true is returned as a single-element array, even if it is also a Group2d.
A Group2d with no label children returns an empty array.
A non-label, non-Group2d geometry returns an empty array.
detail.summary: Returns the text-label geometries associated with the supplied geometry. A label geometry returns itself, a group returns its direct label children, and other geometries produce an empty list.

specTests.when: getTextLabels is called with that geometry.
specTests.then: The result is a one-element array containing the identical geometry object.

specTests.when: getTextLabels is called with the group.
specTests.then: The result contains only the direct label children, in their original order.

specTests.when: getTextLabels is called with that geometry.
specTests.then: The result is an empty array.
